purpose: Explain that a collection or task area has no content.
avoid: Distinguish empty, unavailable and failed loading.
basis: Native source page 1186:3809 (Empty), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: The reason for absence and recovery action are text; a decorative empty-state icon is optional.
updatesAndDescendants: The native wrappers do not distinguish loading, empty and failure automatically. The caller chooses this empty state after successful loading with zero items, replaces it when items arrive, and retains focus on an invoking action where possible.
referenceDecision: A caller-owned empty/data decision is explicit. Error and loading use their own feedback rather than being mislabeled as an empty collection.
